test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Amongst six people, P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different weight. R is heavier than T. U is lighter than P. Q is lighter than T but heavier than S. S is heavier than P. Who is the heaviest amongst them?
solution:
Given: Amongst six people, P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different weight.

1) R is heavier than T.

R > T

2) U is lighter than P.

P > U

3) Q is lighter than T but heavier than S.

T > Q > S

4) S is heavier than P.

T > Q > S > P

Thus, final arrangement:

R > T > Q > S > P > U

So, **R** is the heaviest amongst them.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
